input: Find a local macramé workshop to try once

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Without knowing the user's location or city, it is impossible to surface relevant local workshops.
Knowing which days or time windows the user is free determines which workshop schedules are actually viable.
Workshop prices vary widely — knowing a budget ceiling rules out options that are too expensive.
Macramé workshops range from wall hangings to plant hangers to jewellery; the specific project type affects which class fits best.
Whether the user is going solo or with others changes the need for group bookings or seats for multiple people.
Some users prefer a social studio setting, others a small intimate class or even a private lesson — this shapes which format to prioritise.
Understanding whether the goal is purely to try the craft casually or to produce a finished take-home piece clarifies what a satisfying workshop looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local one-time macramé workshop
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and attend a single macramé workshop available in their local area.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood should the search be in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location so workshops within a practical travel distance can be found.

questions.title: Which days of the week are you free to attend?
questions.description: Establish the user's availability so only workshops with compatible schedules are considered.

questions.title: What is the most you would spend on this class?
questions.description: Set a budget ceiling to filter out workshops that are too costly.

questions.title: Is there a specific macramé project type you want to make?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preference for a particular project — e.g., wall hanging, plant hanger, bag — to match them with the right class focus.

questions.title: Will you be attending alone or bringing someone with you?
questions.description: Find out if multiple seats need to be booked or if a group-friendly setting is preferred.

questions.title: Do you prefer a large social class or a small intimate setting?
questions.description: Understand the user's preferred class format so the shortlist reflects their comfort level and learning style.

questions.title: Is the main goal to relax and explore, or to finish a take-home piece?
questions.description: Clarify what a successful workshop experience looks like — casual exploration versus completing a concrete project.
